name: UV WEATHERING TEST CHAMBER
desc: Smart Programmable Tower-Type UV Accelerated Weathering Test Chamber engineered for simulation of long-term outdoor degradation effects. Features an SS304 tower configuration, 8 high-performance UV lamps, and a 7-inch color touchscreen controller for automated testing cycles.
features: Tower Type design with samples loaded onto vertical fixtures via round clamps
Fully programmable automated loops for illumination, condensation, and water spray
8 Nos. heavy-duty 40 Watts UV lamps positioned at front and rear side layers
Precision adjustable irradiance output power spanning from 0 to 1.0 w/cm2
Integrated high-efficiency Spray Nozzles driven by automated internal Motor Pump

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Smart Programmable Tower-Type UV Weathering Test Chamber
specifications.Primary System Architecture: Tower Type design with samples loaded onto vertical fixtures via round clamps
specifications.Primary Simulation Matrix: Simultaneous or cyclical exposure to ultraviolet radiation, forced condensation, and rain
specifications.Inner Chamber Dimensions: Spacious cleanroom workspace sizing measured at 1170 × 400 × 500 mm
specifications.External Cabinet Dimensions: Structural outer chassis footprint tracking at 1350 × 550 × 1500 mm (WxDxH)
specifications.Standard Specimen Capacity: Configured with matching vertical sample holders sized at 75 × 290 mm (L x W)
specifications.Testing Standards Compliance: Certified full parameters matching ASTM G154/G53, ASTM D4329, ASTM D4587, and SAE J2020
specifications.Chassis Fabrication Material: 100 percent premium corrosion-resistant high-durability Stainless Steel 304 (SS304)
specifications.Ultraviolet Heat Spectrum: Controlled processing thermal environment from Ambient plus 10°C up to 70°C
specifications.Temperature Feedback Sensor: Industrial-grade integrated high-precision PT100 RTD thermal tracker
specifications.Thermal Uniformity Factor: Consistent multi-position spatial tracking within plus or minus 1°C
specifications.Thermal Fluctuation Index: Ultra-precise micro-stabilization calibrated at plus or minus 0.5°C
specifications.Primary Automation Controller: 7 Inch interactive color touchscreen controller with fixed and programmable modes
specifications.Cycle Sequence Setting: Fully programmable automated loops for illumination, condensation, and water spray
specifications.Radiation Light Source Array: 8 Nos. heavy-duty 40 Watts UV lamps positioned at front and rear side layers
specifications.Ultraviolet Wave Alternatives: High-purity UV-A (315-400nm) or UV-B (280-315nm) selections with 1300 hours lifetime
specifications.Irradiance Adjustment Range: Precision adjustable irradiance output power spanning from 0 to 1.0 w/cm2
specifications.Chamber Relative Humidity: Heavy moisture saturation display showing greater than or equal to 90 percent RH
specifications.Precipitation Spray Mechanism: Integrated high-efficiency Spray Nozzles driven by automated internal Motor Pump

specifications.Convection Air Circulation: Dynamically balanced high-efficiency industrial blower assembly with direct ducting
specifications.System Sequence Operational Timer: Precision digital process clock programmable from 0 up to 999 Hours maximum
specifications.Failsafe System Protections: Overload short circuit, over temperature, water lack, earth leakage, and auto shut-off
specifications.Electrical Power Inputs: Standard 220 Volts, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable Indian plug mains connection

specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on controller matrix and chassis
